requirements: Compare the same patient list, answer snapshot, matching policy, and reporting endpoint.
Use a held-out or external cohort compatible with the per-test DNA/RNA contract.
Recall must be no worse than the frozen legacy reference.
F1 must be higher than the frozen legacy reference.
Review TP gained/lost and FP added/removed; no clinically unacceptable new false-positive pattern may be hidden by an aggregate metric.
Manual High-review flags must be reported separately from deterministic model performance.
OBER remains outside this replacement decision unless explicitly added later.

development_cohort_context_only.interpretation: Promising internal result, but endpoints and cohort reuse prevent it from proving external superiority.
